mapName: A Learnable Meta World - Google Cars - Beginner

metas.name: American Samoa - Unique car
metas.note: If you see a Street View car with a slightly rusted black truck bed, you know you're in American Samoa.
metas.footer: Check out https://www.plonkit.net/ for more clues.

metas.name: Argentina - Landscape + black car
metas.note:
If you find yourself in a flat, desolate, treeless, sparsely populated area with a visible black back of the Google car, you're likely in Argentina.

(Jordan might resemble this landscape for new players, and it also has a black back on the car, so be aware of that.)

(Only other countries in South America with car like that are: Peru and Uruguay)
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/argentina for more clues.

metas.name: Bermuda - Unique car
metas.note: If you see a black Street View car with the entire front side of the vehicle visible, you're in Bermuda.
metas.footer: Check out https://www.plonkit.net/ for more clues.

metas.name: Christmas Island - Unique car
metas.note: If you see a Street View car with only the bed of a silver pickup truck visible, you know you're on Christmas Island.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/christmas-island for more clues.

metas.name: Curacao - Unique car
metas.note:
This black Street View car with a roof rack is unique to Curaçao.

It also has white sticker on front left/back right of roof rack.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/curacao for more clues.

metas.name: Dominican Republic - Unique car
metas.note:
A Street View car with a white front and a roof rack filled with thick black rubber stripes is unique to the Dominican Republic. Only the capital Santo Domingo and the Northern city of Santiago de los Caballeros are covered.

With this landscape - similar cars can be found in Guatemala and Curaçao, but they lack the thick black stripes.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/dominican-republic for more clues.

metas.name: Ghana - Unique car
metas.note: All regular road coverage in Ghana features a unique Google car with a visible roof rack and a piece of black tape on the right end of the front bar. The hood is usually visible, displaying a Street View car wrapping with a red rectangle and other distinctive elements.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/ghana for more clues.

metas.name: Guam - Unique car
metas.note:
The entire Google car is blurred, however an antenna at the front right and a tiny part of the roof rack can be seen. You can confuse it with:

  • Puerto Rico(Cars there won't have front plates, signs will be Spanish).
  • Northern Mariana Islands(Antenna there will be noticeably closer to the camera but as long you will go Guam/NMI and not Puerto Rico you will get good score.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/guam for more clues.

metas.name: Guatemala - Unique car
metas.note: This gray Street View car with a visible roof rack and mirrors is unique to Guatemala. Don’t confuse it with the Dominican Republic car, which has black stripes on the roof rack, or the Curaçao car, which has a black front. A similar car is found in Laos, so always check the surroundings before making a guess.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/guatemala for more clues.

metas.name: Jordan - Black car meta
metas.note: While driving on the right side, yellow outer lines with white middle lines are commonly found in Jordan, Israel, and the UAE. The black back of the Google car without an antenna can help confirm you’re in Jordan 100%.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/jordan for more clues.

metas.name: Kenya - Unique car
metas.note:
If you see a snorkel on the Google car, you’re in Kenya.

However, the car is sometimes seen without it, so don’t rule out Kenya if the snorkel isn’t visible.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/kenya for more clues.

metas.name: Kyrgyzstan - Unique car
metas.note: Kyrgyzstan can be recognized by the silver Google car with four visible bars. Coverage was done during winter, so trees often lack leaves, the landscape appears drab, and snow is visible in many areas.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/kyrgyzstan for more clues.

metas.name: Laos - Unique car
metas.note:
If you are in South East Asia with this roof-rack car you gonna be in one of 4 cities in Laos: Vang Vieng, Luang Prabang, Savannakhet, and Pakse.

Note: You can find similar car in Guatemala so look around before making a guess.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/laos for more clues.

metas.name: Mongolia - Unique car
metas.note:
Gen4 Mongolia coverage was taken with two unique pickup trucks:

-White-Blue themed pickup truck mostly found only in Capital

-Pickup truck with a tent on top
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/mongolia for more clues.

metas.name: Mongolia - Unique car
metas.note: The Street View car with a tent on top is unique to Mongolia. While Mongolia has other unique Google cars, this is the most common one.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/mongolia for more clues.

metas.name: Namibia - Pickup truck
metas.note:
Namibia is the newest African country with coverage featuring the white pickup truck.

The landscape is similar to Botswana—flat and dry. Roads typically have yellow outer lines, and driving is on the left side.

Note: You may not always be on main roads with outer yellow lines. In such cases, it can resemble some parts of Kenya, which also drives on the left and sometimes features the white pickup truck.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/namibia for more clues.

metas.name: Northern Mariana Islands - Unique car
metas.note:
The entire Google car is blurred, but an antenna at the front right can still be seen. It will feel noticeably closer to the car than in other countries with a similar car.

You can confuse it with:

  • Puerto Rico(Cars there won't have front plates, signs will be Spanish).
  • Guam (You should be able to see little part of roof rack but as long you will guess NMI or Guam and not Peurto Rico you will get good points)
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/northern-mariana-islands for more clues.

metas.name: Qatar - Car meta
metas.note:
Qatar's landscape is predominantly desert, with arid, mostly flat expanses of sand as far as the eye can see. You will often not see many trees or other greenery.

The Google car will usually be blurred, with only the antenna on the left and a sliver of the car visible. Sometimes the entire white pickup truck can be visible.

You might occasionally confuse it with the UAE or Oman pickup truck coverage, but in those countries, the antenna on the pickup car will be in the middle.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/qatar for more clues.

metas.name: Reunion - Unique car
metas.note:
Réunion's Street View car features visible side mirrors, a roof rack, and black tape at the end of the rear right bar.

Don’t confuse this with the Ghana car, which has tape on the front right bar.
metas.footer: Check out https://www.plonkit.net/ for more clues.

metas.name: Sri Lanka - Unique car
metas.note: In most Generation 3 Sri Lanka coverage, you will be able to see the front of the Google car partially through the blur. It appears as blue-white-red patches, reminiscent of the French flag, with the red patch usually being the most visually distinct.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/sri-lanka for more clues.

metas.name: Uganda - Unique car
metas.note: Uganda's unique Google car is white with visible square mirrors, and its coverage is limited to Kampala. Some national parks in Uganda are covered with different cars, but these are quite rare.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/uganda for more clues.

metas.name: Ukraine - Red car meta
metas.note: A red Google car, with or without an antenna, in Generation 3 and on crappy roads is always Ukraine. However, the car may not always be visible, so don’t rule out Ukraine if you don’t see it.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/ukraine for more clues.

metas.name: United Arab Emirates - Silver car
metas.note: If you have vibes/other clues that you are in the middle east and you have silver car in Gen3 that means you can only be in UAE.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/united-arab-emirates for more clues.

metas.name: US Virgin Islands - USV unique car
metas.note: Car coverage on the islands will have a large, visible street view car, which will either be red or white.(Don't confuse it with Bermuda google car which is full black)
metas.footer: Check out https://www.plonkit.net/ for more clues.
